_note: Curated odoo.tools symbols for Odoo 19.0. KEY CHANGES: safe_eval signature is BREAKING (keyword-only args, test_expr removed). pycompat dropped from odoo.tools.__init__. SQL class stable. read_group deprecated. Marking safe_eval as deprecated here because the SIGNATURE change is breaking for existing call sites. image_process's flat re-export was ALSO dropped from odoo.tools.__init__ at v19 (same mechanism as pycompat) - per this schema's status doc, a name that no longer resolves is 'removed' (omit it), not 'deprecated' (deprecated still resolves, just discouraged - see odoo.tools.html_escape below for a genuine example); the flat odoo.tools.image_process qualified_name is therefore intentionally OMITTED here, only the real resolving odoo.tools.image.image_process path is listed. INVESTIGATED AND CONFIRMED CORRECT (issue #364 follow-up, prompted by the tools_symbols oracle landing): odoo/tools/__init__.py at v19 ALSO no longer references date_utils or js_transpiler in any form (no 'from . import date_utils'/'from .date_utils import *', no 'from . import js_transpiler'/'from .js_transpiler import ...' - confirmed absent by direct read of v19's odoo/tools/__init__.py). This LOOKS like the same shape as pycompat (v8-v10, module absent -> omitted) and image_process (v19, flat re-export dropped -> omitted, replaced by dotted path) but is NOT: date_utils.py and js_transpiler.py are themselves real submodule files sitting directly under odoo/tools/ (confirmed present on disk at v19), so 'from odoo.tools import date_utils' / 'from odoo.tools import js_transpiler' keep resolving via Python's own from-package-import submodule fallback (importing 'name' from a package falls back to importing 'package.name' as a submodule when 'name' is not already bound as an attribute) - this fallback is unconditional and does not depend on odoo/tools/__init__.py importing them at all. Verified empirically in a fresh interpreter against a fully dependency-installed real v19 checkout (~/git/odoo19 via the python-venv/3.12/odoo19 venv): both imports succeed and return the real submodule objects. Both are also genuinely used elsewhere in v19 core via their qualified paths (odoo/orm/domains.py: 'from odoo.tools.date_utils import parse_date, parse_iso_date'; odoo/orm/fields_temporal.py: 'from odoo.tools import SQL, date_utils'; odoo/addons/base/models/assetsbundle.py: 'from odoo.tools.js_transpiler import transpile_javascript, is_odoo_module, ...'), so they are not orphaned/dead code either. By contrast, image_process was a flat FUNCTION name (not itself a submodule file - it lives inside image.py), so no such fallback applied once its explicit re-export line was removed; that is the real, structural reason the two cases differ, not a coincidence. Individual functions inside date_utils.py/js_transpiler.py (start_of, end_of, add, subtract, transpile_javascript, is_odoo_module, etc.) are correctly NOT curated as separate flat odoo.tools.* entries here - verified those do NOT resolve flat (e.g. 'from odoo.tools import start_of' raises AttributeError), which would be the genuine image_process-shaped defect; the two curated entries below are 'signature: module' qualified_names for the submodules themselves, which is the still-resolving form, same convention as odoo.tools.config (config.py) and (through v18) odoo.tools.pycompat. All 18 symbols in this file were re-verified to resolve against the real v19 checkout as part of this pass (odoo_source-marked tests + a full-file resolution sweep); status left unchanged for all of them - a false 'fix' here would have been the same class of error as the original date_utils/js_transpiler-looks-broken false alarm.

Also genuinely imported elsewhere in v19 core (odoo/addons/base/models/assetsbundle.py: 'from odoo.tools.js_transpiler import transpile_javascript, is_odoo_module, ...'). Correctly 'stable', not 'removed' - investigated for issue #364 and confirmed, not changed.
